notes.title: NineDarkDream Opinion gathering
notes.notes:
A person development for a long time, the total feeling is behind closed doors, as a new developer, I hope to hear the views of players!
I hope everyone will give me a comment on my game, whether it is criticism or hope for the features of the game. Thank you for leaving your comments, and thank you for your support of my game!
If your comment is very long, I hope you can briefly explain your requirements first and then explain your requirements in detail. Thank you
